# migadu_domain (Resource)

Manages a Migadu domain.

~> The Migadu API does not support domain deletion. Destroying this resource removes it from Terraform state only. The domain must be deleted manually from the Migadu admin panel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "migadu_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

# The domain exposes all required DNS records as computed attributes.
# Use them to configure your DNS provider — here with Cloudflare.

resource "cloudflare_record" "migadu_verify" {
  zone_id = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name    = migadu_domain.example.dns_verification.name
  type    = upper(migadu_domain.example.dns_verification.type)
  content = migadu_domain.example.dns_verification.value
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "migadu_spf" {
  zone_id = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name    = migadu_domain.example.spf.name
  type    = upper(migadu_domain.example.spf.type)
  content = migadu_domain.example.spf.value
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "migadu_dmarc" {
  zone_id = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name    = migadu_domain.example.dmarc.name
  type    = upper(migadu_domain.example.dmarc.type)
  content = migadu_domain.example.dmarc.value
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "migadu_dkim" {
  for_each = { for r in migadu_domain.example.dkim_records : r.name => r }
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = each.value.name
  type     = upper(each.value.type)
  content  = each.value.value
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "migadu_mx" {
  for_each = { for r in migadu_domain.example.mx_records : r.value => r }
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = each.value.name
  type     = upper(each.value.type)
  content  = each.value.value
  priority = each.value.priority
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain name.

### Optional

- `can_access` (Boolean) Whether the domain can access the Migadu panel.
- `catchall_destinations` (List of String) Catchall destination addresses.
- `create_default_addresses` (Boolean) Whether to create default mailbox addresses on creation. Has no effect after creation.
- `description` (String) Description of the domain.
- `greylisting_enabled` (Boolean) Whether greylisting is enabled.
- `hosted_dns` (Boolean) Whether Migadu hosts the DNS for this domain.
- `junk_subject_keyword_spam` (Boolean) Whether junk subject keyword spam detection is enabled.
- `mx_proxy_enabled` (Boolean) Whether MX proxy is enabled.
- `recipient_denylist` (List of String) List of denied recipients.
- `sender_allowlist` (List of String) List of allowed senders.
- `sender_denylist` (List of String) List of denied senders.
- `spam_aggressiveness` (String) Spam aggressiveness level.
- `subject_rewriting_enabled` (Boolean) Whether subject rewriting is enabled.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the domain.

### Read-Only

- `activated_at` (String) When the domain was activated.
- `can_receive` (Boolean) Whether the domain can receive email.
- `can_send` (Boolean) Whether the domain can send email.
- `deactivated_at` (String) When the domain was deactivated.
- `dkim_records` (Attributes List) DKIM DNS records to add (one per key). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim_records))
- `dmarc` (Attributes) DMARC DNS record to add. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dmarc))
- `dns_verification` (Attributes) DNS ownership verification record to add. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_verification))
- `mx_records` (Attributes List) MX DNS records to add. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mx_records))
- `spf` (Attributes) SPF DNS record to add. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spf))
- `state` (String) The domain state.
